clips.title: The story
paras: Velinde Starsong's personal journal records her duties and the mystery of her departure from Darnassus. The Night Elf priestess's journal is stored in the Sentinel bunkhouse.

When Night Elf priestess Velinde Starsong left Darnassus, her belongings were locked in a footlocker at the Sentinels' bunkhouse in the Tradesmen's Terrace. Among them was her personal journal, a record of her responsibilities and duties. The Sentinels respected Velinde and believed she had left to attend to private matters. Her journal's contents suggest her unexplained absence is more troubling than they first believed.
